mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_request (register_id, medical_technology_id, check_info, check_position, creation_time, check_state) VALUES (#{registerId}, #{medicalTechnologyId}, #{checkInfo}, #{checkPosition}, #{creationTime}, '1')

where.if: AND c.creation_time >= CONCAT(#{creationDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND c.creation_time < DATE_ADD(#{creationDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, r.case_number, r.real_name, r.gender, r.age, t.tech_name, t.tech_format, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record paid WHERE paid.register_id = c.register_id AND paid.item_type = '检查' AND paid.item_id = c.id AND paid.fee_type = '收费' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_record refunded WHERE refunded.refund_target_id = paid.id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS payment_ready, executor.realname AS check_employee_name, recorder.realname AS inputcheck_employee_name FROM check_request c JOIN register r ON r.id = c.register_id JOIN medical_technology t ON t.id = c.medical_technology_id LEFT JOIN employee executor ON executor.id = c.check_employee_id LEFT JOIN employee recorder ON recorder.id = c.inputcheck_employee_id
ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_request c JOIN register r ON r.id = c.register_id
mapper.update: UPDATE check_request SET check_employee_id = #{employeeId}, check_time = NOW(), check_state = '2' WHERE id = #{id} AND check_state = '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fee_record paid WHERE paid.register_id = check_request.register_id AND paid.item_type = '检查' AND paid.item_id = check_request.id AND paid.fee_type = '收费' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_record refunded WHERE refunded.refund_target_id = paid.id) )
UPDATE check_request SET inputcheck_employee_id = #{employeeId}, check_result = #{result}, check_remark = #{remark}, check_state = '3' WHERE id = #{id} AND check_state = '2'
